scope.removed: Remove common GeolocateControl, facade types/aliases/adapter fields and use-geolocation-control follow/coalescing policy; migrate app UI to raw selected web wrapper controls and ordinary native one-shot button; preserve display and intermediate acquisition services.
scope.retained: UserLocation validation/display/accuracy and GeolocationPosition, raw SDK pucks/follow and native viewState/locationOptions constraints; all acquisition services/types/useMapServices/MapSetup.locationProvider until U18; Control until U17; source/press contracts until U19. Marker portals, ornament options/refresh and peers/patches/locks/version/candidate remain.
scope.web: Raw selected WrapperGeolocateControl uses normal browser geolocation, with no global navigator patch or MapSetup provider interception. showUserLocation=false leaves supplied UserLocation as the app display owner. Source-only browser-driver CDP/Playwright setup owns deterministic position/permission simulation.

native.acquire: One application-supplied Promise; deterministic fixed/delayed fixture or retained services.location.getCurrentPosition({signal}) until U18. No subscription or follow controller.
native.ownership: Own AbortController, block duplicate activation while pending, abort on component disposal/key replacement; only a current request and concrete map identity can dispatch or notify. TF07 generation, TF08 generation/mode and native focused mode own their button keys.
native.errors: Reject invalid coordinates before dispatch; current acquisition/camera errors reach the app callback and permit retry. Retired acquisition/camera resolutions and failures are ignored.
native.display: App supplies received position to retained UserLocation. Raw web controls set showUserLocation=false so exactly the app-owned display path owns puck/accuracy. Native callback success means camera dispatch acknowledged, not observed completion.
native.placement: TF07 scale top64/left8, compass top148/right8 below three44px camera buttons; location top8/left8. TF08 location top8/right8 and coverage compass top64/right8. Native focused first location top8/right8/compass64right8, second compass104right8 below two44px camera buttons. SDK enablement defaults preserved.

scope.data: No live sensor, storage or database operation ran. One-shot app examples use fixed/delayed fixtures or retained explicit service calls until U18; no watch/follow framework relocated.

findings.classification: Introduced TF08 isolation defect found after initial freeze; earlier signoff superseded.
findings.origin: Introduced by U16 moving position state from the keyed common control to the persistent TF08 scene parent. Reconfiguring/remounting the map no longer discarded the previous supplied position, allowing stale common blue geometry into capture baseline or raw native puck coverage.
findings.fix: Clear displayPosition for every configure command in both scenes. Omit common UserLocation during native coverage-puck so the raw selected SDK puck is its only display owner even if the application button delivers a fresh fix. Web coverage-puck still accepts a fresh raw-wrapper callback into common supplied display because the raw control has showUserLocation=false.
findings.red: Four regression cases failed in each tree because the old coordinate survived coverage-base.
findings.proof: Independent actual mocked scene rerun passes; exactly two scenes and their tests changed.104 library source hashes unchanged between freezes. Source/mock isolation protects the capture oracle; no pixels were observed.
